data.subject: Inquiry: AI Spokesperson — Jharkhand
data.message:
We are looking for a technology partner to develop an AI-powered WhatsApp medicine-ordering system.

Our key requirements are:
Understand medicine requests in English, Hindi and Hinglish, including misspellings.
Search and match products from a database of approximately 750,000 medicines using fuzzy search.
Show relevant variants and allow customers to select the correct product.
Maintain conversation memory for responses
Maintain a cart and allow adding/modifying medicines and quantities.
Retrieve verified MRP, pack size and product details directly from the database.
Automatically calculate pricing/discounts and generate the final order summary on WhatsApp.
Support human-agent handover when required.
Please let us know if your team can build such a system. If yes, kindly share any similar work, your proposed approach, approximate timeline and indicative cost.

State: Jharkhand
